All four family forces use the frozen original float32 forces_at result promoted exactly to float64, evaluated at integer-grid midpoints and held at actual handle origins. Twist is an equal/opposite two-force couple with exactly zero resultant, not a substituted pure torque.

Per-handle stable center increments/work and actual start/end centers/cross-force moments support independent work and torque reconstruction. Frozen core fixture reactions include inertia/elasticity/drag; body drag and discrete momentum/work defects remain recorded.
